english.note: Use this when a government, party, group, or coalition breaks into opposing factions.
Use this for splitting a group socially or politically, especially when disagreement or hostility results.

examples.english: The political party began to splinter into two factions over policy differences.
This dispute caused the political party to divide.
examples.traditional: 呢場爭論令個政黨分裂。
